full_prompt_en: A square sports-anime illustration shows a black-haired young soccer player lunging diagonally toward a ball at the right edge. The close viewpoint looks slightly down at the action, making his head and upper body large while the limbs extend beyond the crop. Thick windswept hair fans toward the upper left in layered black shapes with gray highlights. His wide dark eyes focus intensely just to the right of the viewer, with the black pupils ringed by pale blue-gray. The mouth is open a little, showing a narrow white flash of teeth, and the brows angle inward. He wears a saturated cobalt-blue jersey with a white V-shaped collar, a red band at the sleeve, and a small pair of red-and-yellow marks on the chest. Deep navy folds across the torso and shoulder give the shirt a rounded volume. One bare arm reaches through the lower left foreground, its warm peach skin interrupted by decisive brown shadow shapes. Another arm stretches back toward the upper right, mostly cut by the frame. A portion of a black-and-white soccer ball presses against the right border, so the ball and the player's forward movement meet at the edge. White shorts are glimpsed below the blue shirt. The background is not a literal field; it is a rough, high-energy field of bright ocher yellow and cobalt blue, with scratched marks, flecks, and dry brush patches scattered behind the figure. Strong dark linework encloses the face and clothing, while broad clean color areas make the action legible immediately. Light is bright and even, with angular shaded planes under the fringe, chin, and arm rather than soft cast shadows. The close crop, diagonal reach, and jagged painted background turn a single athletic instant into a vivid forward surge.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形运动动漫插画描绘一名黑发年轻足球运动员斜向扑向右边缘的球。近距离视点略向下看，使他的头和上半身很大，四肢则伸出画边。浓密的迎风头发以层叠黑形和灰色亮痕向左上展开。他宽大的暗眼紧盯观者右侧，黑色瞳孔外有浅蓝灰眼环。嘴微张，露出细窄白齿，双眉向内倾斜。他穿饱和钴蓝球衣，领口为白色 V 形，袖上有红色带，胸口有一对小小红黄记号。深海军蓝褶线穿过躯干与肩，使球衣有圆润体积。一只裸露手臂伸入左下前景，暖桃色皮肤被果断棕影分割。另一只手臂伸向右上后方，大部分被画框裁去。一部分黑白足球贴在右边框旁，因此球与人物向前的动势在边缘相遇。蓝衣下还能看到一角白短裤。背景不是写实球场，而是一片高能量的亮赭黄与钴蓝色域，刮痕、飞点和干笔斑块散在人物身后。强劲深色线工框住脸与衣服，宽阔纯净色面使动作立刻可读。光明亮而均匀，额发下、下巴和手臂下面是棱角分明的阴影平面，而非柔软投影。贴近裁切、斜向伸展和锯齿般绘制的背景，把一个运动瞬间变成鲜明的向前冲势。
style_prompt_en: Anime illustration combines thick clean contours, broad saturated color planes, and sharp faceted shadow shapes. Cobalt blue and hot ocher occupy competing large areas, while small red accents and pale highlights punctuate the center. Near forms are greatly enlarged by a tight crop, and diagonal extensions carry energy beyond the frame. Dark layered strokes give the central silhouette weight; dry scratches, flecks, and uneven paint at the edge make the background restless without obscuring it. Bright even illumination keeps each color separate, while angular shadows supply depth and directional force. The overall rhythm is immediate and graphic, balancing clear focal detail against rougher peripheral marks.
style_prompt_zh: 动漫插画结合粗而清楚的轮廓、宽阔饱和色面与锐利棱面阴影。钴蓝与炽热赭黄占据互相对抗的大面积，小块红色点缀和浅色高光在中央起节奏。近形被紧贴裁切显著放大，斜向延伸把能量带到画框之外。深色层叠笔迹给予中心剪影重量；边沿的干刮痕、飞点与不匀颜料让背景躁动，却不遮住中心。明亮均匀的照明让各色保持分离，棱角阴影则供应纵深与方向性力量。整体节奏直接且图形化，在清楚焦点细节和较粗放的外围笔迹之间平衡。
theme_en: A black-haired soccer player lunging toward a ball in blue uniform
theme_zh: 一名黑发足球运动员穿蓝色球衣冲向足球
name: Captain Tsubasa
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
